relations.name: assigned_to
relations.description: Subject person, role, unit, or responsibility is assigned to the object organization, role, mission, or process.

relations.name: commands
relations.description: Subject commander, role, or organization commands the object unit, force, mission, or operation.

relations.name: coordinates_with
relations.description: Subject organization, role, or process coordinates with the object organization, role, or process.

relations.name: provides
relations.description: Subject provides the object capability, resource, guidance, support, or service.

relations.name: contains
relations.description: Subject document, collection, system, or process contains the object section, requirement, record, or component.

relations.name: implements
relations.description: Subject process, system, organization, or document implements the object policy, requirement, procedure, or standard.

relations.name: evaluates
relations.description: Subject person, role, process, or document evaluates the object performance, qualification, unit, or process.

relations.name: trains_for
relations.description: Subject training, role, or process prepares the object person, role, unit, mission, operation, or procedure.

relations.name: operates
relations.description: Subject person, role, unit, or organization operates the object aircraft, system, equipment, or capability.

relations.name: stored_in
relations.description: Subject record, publication, or collection is stored in the object archive, repository, collection, or system.
